subject: general
question: Which of the following is a sexually transmitted viral disease?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AIDS**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **AIDS (Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome)** is caused by the Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV).
 
• It is a sexually transmitted infection that can also be spread through contact with infected blood, from mother to child during pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding.
 
• HIV attacks and weakens the body's immune system, making the individual more susceptible to infections and certain cancers.
 
• There is currently no cure for AIDS, but antiretroviral therapy (ART) can manage and control the virus, improving the quality of life for those infected.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus)**

 
 
• HIV is a retrovirus that primarily infects components of the human immune system such as CD4+ T cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells.
 
• Without treatment, HIV infection progresses in stages, starting with acute infection, then clinical latency, and finally, AIDS.
 
 
 
• **Antiretroviral Therapy (ART)**
 
 
• ART involves taking a combination of HIV medicines (called an HIV treatment regimen) every day.
 
• ART helps reduce the viral load in the blood, maintain immune system function, and prevent onward transmission of the virus.
 
 
 
• **Prevention of HIV/AIDS**
 
 
• Practicing safe sex by using condoms.
 
• Regular HIV testing and counseling.
 
• Using pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) for those at high risk.
 
• Avoiding sharing needles or syringes.
 
 
 
• **Global Impact**
 
 
• According to UNAIDS, in 2020, there were approximately 37.7 million people living with HIV worldwide.
 
• Sub-Saharan Africa remains the most severely affected region, with nearly 1 in every 25 adults (3.6%) living with HIV.
